title: Opt-in coarse-candidate deduplication before fine search
semantics: SEMANTICS-CHANGING research option. Fewer coarse candidates are refined, so matches and proposals are NOT expected to equal the baseline. No exact-equivalence claim is made. GUI, core and research defaults stay top_k=0 regardless of the outcome.
baseline: Same build, same job, candidate_dedup_top_k=0 (every coarse candidate refined, the round-40 behaviour). Speedups are never multiplied with earlier rounds.
independence: Round 42 (exact parallel peak selection) is a separate round in another branch; this build does not contain it and nothing here is combined with it.

rule.where: fpm::detail::matchWithCoarseNcc after the coarse candidate stable sort (hybrid: CPU or Metal frame), and kernels fg_dedup_mark/fg_dedup_apply between coarse peaks and fg_fine_search (full GPU). Per scale model.
rule.rank: coarse score descending, ties by insertion order (hybrid) / slot order (full GPU); the two orders are the same map-major peak order
rule.center: top-level corner + 0.5*(w*cos - h*sin, w*sin + h*cos) with the top-level template size, times 2^top (source pixels)
rule.drop: a candidate is dropped when at least top_k candidates ranked before it (kept or dropped) have centers within R = radius*(1-maxOverlap)*min(level-0 template width, height) and wrapped search angles within angle_steps*atan(2/max(top width, height))
rule.order: kept candidates keep their relative order; fine search, per-model NMS, refinement and final NMS are unchanged
rule.precision: hybrid binary64 on binary64 coarse scores; full GPU FP32 on FP32 coarse scores; decisions can differ between paths because their coarse inputs differ

k1_wide_radius.role: negative-control ablation: radius above the separation of objects that can both be output

parameter_rationale: radius 0.5: two same-angle, same-scale objects can both pass the research NMS only if their centers are at least (1-maxOverlap)*min side apart; R is half of that, leaving the other half for the coarse localization error of both objects.

angle_steps 3 (>= top_k): on a monotone coarse score-versus-angle slope a candidate has at least three higher neighbours within the window and is dropped; distinct symmetric modes more than three coarse steps apart keep separate neighbourhoods.
top_k 3 is the task's starting point; k2/k1 are reported as sensitivity, not as the decision.

paths.hybrid: round-40 hybrid_best job (benchmark_gpu_ncc_closure.job): Metal coarse with exact CPU normalization, Metal fine and pose refinement
paths.full_gpu: round-40 full_gpu_simd job: full_gpu=true, peak mode 1, fine mode 4; scale-support (CPU) cases are hybrid-only

cases.r40: controlled6, heldout12, small_fullres, 8k_t256_angle180_3scales, many128_pose, many512_pose, boundary_one, empty_scene, constant_source (stage-37 fixtures, hashes checked); many128_holdout, many512_holdout; many128_pose_stop0, many512_pose_stop0
cases.r34_challenge: development/heldout x occlusion (known failure), distractors (hard negatives), contact (touching, 12%/30% overlap pairs)
cases.r33: new_texture12, new_small12 (known failure), degraded12 (known failure), r33_empty_scene, many512_pose_fullres_subpixel
cases.r34_scale: the 33 frozen stage-34 scale-support scenes (24 Dst4 small-template, 8 Dst10/Dst3 controls, retained new_small12), each without and with scale_support_refine (the latter hybrid only)
cases.r35: 8 semi-synthetic 49-object RGB scenes (gray through the runner's 77/150/29 conversion) with the tuned round-35 search and with the original budget (min_area 256, proposal .5, limit 100; development is a known failure). FSC and VisA have no pose truth and are excluded.
cases.r43_controls: sym_marker12 (180-degree symmetric template with a zero-mean fine marker, scales 0.95..1.05) and adjacent_grid16 (16 Dst3 copies 1.04 template sizes apart, max pair overlap <= 0.2), generated by tools/candidate_dedup_scenes.py into the experiment directory

phases.gt: every case variant x applicable path x arm, one fresh process each, first call + 1 repeat; up to 2 workers in parallel (no timing claims from this phase)
phases.pilot: one formal block, run after the GT phase; screening only, never decision evidence
phases.formal: cases many128_pose, many512_pose, controlled6, 8k_t256_angle180_3scales; arms (hybrid,off),(hybrid,k3),(full_gpu,off),(full_gpu,k3); 6 blocks, order reversed on odd blocks; fresh process per case/arm/block; first call (cold, excluded), >=1 s warm-up, 3 measured calls; clock = runner total_ms (excludes decode, Session construction, JSON and truth)
phases.profile: many128_pose and many512_pose, full_gpu off/k3 with encoder timestamps and fine-work counters; 1 process each, 3 measured calls; never compared with formal timings

accuracy.strict: many_object_accuracy.evaluate: one-to-one, position <= 2 px, wrapped angle <= 1 degree, scale ratio within 2%; FP and FN both counted; no symmetry aliasing allowed
accuracy.gt_neutral_rule: a path is GT-neutral for an arm when no case variant has fewer strict TP or more strict FP than its same-path off arm (first call); known-failure and control cases included
accuracy.output_identity: ordered matches and ordered proposals (pose, score, scale, corners) compared exactly with the same-path off arm; reported separately; not a gate and not expected
accuracy.repeat: each worker's repeat must equal its first call exactly (runner) and give the same GT counts

negative_controls.unit: candidate_dedup_test (grid filter equals the quadratic definition on 300 random trials; symmetric two-mode and adjacent two-object controls), full_gpu_dedup_test (Metal kernels equal dedupKeep on FP32 slot layouts), candidate_dedup_pipeline_test (off path identical, counters, residency, CPU=Metal hybrid decisions, invalid options)
negative_controls.scenes: k1_position_only is expected to lose objects on sym_marker12 and k1_wide_radius on adjacent_grid16; a control that does not fail is reported as not demonstrated, not rerun
negative_controls.harness: tests/test_candidate_dedup_harness.py: GT regression, output-only change, counter contracts, residency, changed evidence, missing worker, non-repeating worker, speed/time/RSS/host/GT formal gates, order and job-key contracts

gates.speed_target: k3 total_ms pooled median at least 10% below off, with all 6 paired block medians in the same direction, on many128_pose and many512_pose, judged per path
gates.time_budget: controlled6 and 8k: each block k3 <= off + max(2 ms, 10%)
gates.rss: each block peak RSS k3 <= off + max(8 MiB, 10%)
gates.gt: every formal call zero strict FP/FN (all four formal cases pass at baseline)
gates.residency: full GPU k3: command_buffers 1, cpu_waits 1, intermediate_readbacks 0, cpu_algorithm_steps 0
gates.host: no competing build/benchmark process at formal start (hard) or before any formal worker (recorded failure)
gates.identity: formal first-call outputs equal the GT-phase outputs of the same case/path/arm (same build, deterministic)

decision: The option is kept as an opt-in research switch whatever the result. A path is called suitable for a scenario only if it is GT-neutral on every case variant AND meets the speed target on that path; otherwise the failures are reported and kept. No default changes.
memory: Process peak RSS, named Metal allocations (dedup-flags, dedup-counts are new and only allocated when enabled) and pose buffers are reported separately and never added.
pre_registration_disclosure: Before this protocol, implementation smoke runs on many128_pose with k3 (one call per path) were seen: GT 128/0/0 both paths, kept 20188/42458 (hybrid) and 22863/42460 (full GPU), total 884->582 ms (hybrid) and 794->586 ms (full GPU). They are not evidence and no parameter was changed after them.

The two control scenes were iterated before this protocol: a weaker 16x16 +/-45 marker and the generator's 0.72..1.28 scale range left baseline failures (9/12 and 9/12 strict TP), so the marker became 32x32 +/-60 and the scales 0.95..1.05 (baseline 11/12). The ablation arms were fixed at top_k 1 together with these controls because their purpose is to show the GT gate can detect each failure mode, not to estimate a rate.
k3, radius 0.5 and angle_steps 3 were fixed before any run and were not changed.
limits: Single Apple M4 Pro (48 GiB) Metal device
Synthetic or semi-synthetic ground truth; no annotated real image sequence; FSC/VisA excluded for lack of pose truth
GT has no symmetry equivalence: a 180-degree alias is a failure
Sibling sessions may use the machine; host state is recorded for every worker and formal timing refuses to start with competing processes
The stage-34 lifecycle frames and source-sequence mode are not re-run
